verdict.rationale: Publicly stating how engagements are priced is a fair question to ask of a law firm, so this axis applies. However, none of the evidence covers rate structures, alternative fee arrangements or billing practices. The pages cited describe practice areas, clients, offices and publications only.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque
